name: codex-history
description: Browse your Codex conversations with question navigation, Markdown, LaTeX and an answers-only view. Local and private.

interface.shortDescription: Find any question. Read the whole conversation.
interface.longDescription: A refreshable local companion reader with searchable question navigation, continuous conversation history, Markdown, syntax highlighting, LaTeX math, dark mode, message copying and an answers-only toggle. Load new messages with Refresh; optional offline snapshots. Bundled rendering assets; no npm/pip installation.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $history to open this conversation in the local history reader.
